description: This file provides polyfill implementations for ctype functions, allowing code to run with support for ctype functions in environments where they might not be available natively. It conditionally defines functions for character type checks by delegating to the Symfony polyfill classes.

classes.name: p\Ctype
classes.description: Symfony polyfill class implementing ctype functions as static methods.

methods.name: ctype_alnum
methods.description: Checks if the input is alphanumeric using the polyfill.

methods.name: ctype_alpha
methods.description: Checks if the input contains only alphabetic characters.

methods.name: ctype_cntrl
methods.description: Checks if the input contains control characters.

methods.name: ctype_digit
methods.description: Checks if the input contains only digits.

methods.name: ctype_graph
methods.description: Checks if the input contains any printable characters except space.

methods.name: ctype_lower
methods.description: Checks if the input contains only lowercase characters.

methods.name: ctype_print
methods.description: Checks if the input contains only printable characters.

methods.name: ctype_punct
methods.description: Checks if the input contains only punctuation characters.

methods.name: ctype_space
methods.description: Checks if the input contains only whitespace characters.

methods.name: ctype_upper
methods.description: Checks if the input contains only uppercase characters.

methods.name: ctype_xdigit
methods.description: Checks if the input contains only hexadecimal digits.
